value: Every power row carries can_go_negative (default false), the engine's form of the game's AbstractPower.canGoNegative: true for Strength and Dexterity (Wraith Form is stored +n in the engine, so left out). A negative Apply of a power without it acts as the game's ReducePowerAction: floored at 0, nothing when not held, no debuff, no OwnerApplied hooks. Python: sts.power_can_go_negative(name).
